title: Point probabilities of a correlated pair
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{\pm1\}^n$. For a random pair $(X,Y)$ formed by choosing $X$ uniformly from the cube and applying independent coordinate noise to obtain $Y$, with each coordinate retained with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, its point probability is $\mathbb P((X,Y)=(x,y))=2^{-n}\,\mathbb P(Y=y\mid X=x)$.
